body.p: Claims 1 and 3-20 were previously pending. Claims 11-20 were withdrawn from
consideration. In this response, claim 1 is amended. Therefore, following entry of the present amendments, claims 1 and 3-20 are pending.
Applicant's representative Fredrick S. Tsang (Reg. No. 68,680) conducted a telephonic

interview with Examiner Tu on November 6th, 2023. During the interview, pending claims 1 and 3-20 and the rejections to those claims under 35 U.S.C. § 103 were discussed. An agreement was reached during the interview. The Examiner agreed that the pending claims appear to be distinguishable over the currently cited references in view of Applicant's arguments, subject to further search and consideration.
Claim 1 was rejection under U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Niederkrom et al. (US 2014/0366277) in view of Terawaki et al. (US 2011/0308019).

The cited combination of references at least do not disclose "wherein the dielectric layer and the two air-permeable substrates comprise cut-outs at the vertical air pathways," as recited in amended claim 1.

In view of the above, claim 1 is patentable over the cited combination of references. Claims 3-10 all depend from claim 1. As such, all arguments made above with reference to claim 1 are equally applicable to these claims. Therefore, these rejections should be withdrawn.

Based on the foregoing, the application is in condition for allowance, and reconsideration of the application is therefore requested. If the Examiner believes that direct contact would help advance prosecution of this application, the Examiner is encouraged to contact the undersigned.
